# Klaro vendor files

These files are the self-hosted Klaro 0.7.22 browser builds sourced from:

- `https://cdn.kiprotect.com/klaro/v0.7.22/klaro-no-css.js`
- `https://cdn.kiprotect.com/klaro/v0.7.22/klaro.min.css`

Klaro is licensed under BSD-3-Clause; see `LICENSE`. The JavaScript is served
as `/assets/vendor/klaro/klaro-no-css.js`; the CSS is bundled into LibreGrid's
first-party stylesheet and themed in `apps/docs/src/styles.scss`.
